name: Revenge!!! 2 ~Toshishita no Onna Joushi o Taose~
original_name: リベンジ!!! 2 ～年下の女上司を倒せ～
source:
"Nothing good can come from this plan!? Is that what you're saying!?"
She yelled at you as she stood over your desk. She was young and cute, and your superior.
"Are we going to have a problem about this?"
She and you clashed badly. There was a reason for that.
You were classmates back in school. She had it over you in those days, too.
Sports, grades, everything. She was better than you.
So when it comes to f*cking her brains out, you won't lose!

Will you rise to the challenge? Can you beat her in "sex battle"!?

“这个计划不会有什么好处！？你是这么说的吗！？”
她站在你的桌子旁边对你大喊大叫。她年轻又可爱，是你的上司。
“我们会在这方面遇到问题吗？”
她和你发生了严重冲突。这是有原因的。
你们是学校里的同学。那些日子里她也对你很着迷。
体育、成绩，一切。她比你优秀。
所以当谈到操她的大脑时，你不会输！
